latest.notes: Fixes the station going to 'Nothing Playing' when a remote desktop session connects or disconnects. THE root cause: macOS stops AVAudioEngine itself whenever the audio hardware configuration changes — which is exactly what Jump Desktop does when it attaches or detaches its virtual audio device — and the engine never restarts on its own. Nothing in the app was listening for that, so the station silently fell off air until someone relaunched. The engine now watches for the configuration change, re-points at the program output, restarts, and resumes the element that was on air. Repeated connect/disconnect bursts are handled safely.
